name: Young Crocolisk Skin
summary: In the Wetlands, young crocolisks supply hides for trade from Menethil Harbor. James Halloran cures their softer skins and sends them to distant ports.

sections.title: Tanning and Trade in the Marshes
sections.body:
Menethil Harbor ships marsh goods from the western coast of Khaz Modan. Hides are among its most lucrative exports, cured by the town’s resident tanner, James Halloran. Full-grown crocolisks have thick, tough scales, while the young provide softer leather that is easier to work.

The delicate skins are in high demand. Halloran depends on local hunters and passing travelers to search the boggy marshes just outside town and keep his curing racks stocked.

faq.q: Why does James Halloran want skins from young crocolisks specifically?
faq.answer: Young crocolisks have softer hides that are easier to work and cure than the thick, tough scales of mature crocolisks. Their leather is in high demand along sea trade routes.

faq.q: Where can young crocolisks be found?
faq.answer: Young Wetlands Crocolisks live in the waterways, bogs, and marshes just outside Menethil Harbor in the western Wetlands.

faq.q: Who else hunts these crocolisks for the harbor?
faq.answer: Einar, a local hunter, regularly brings crocolisk hides to James Halloran’s leatherworking business. One tracker cannot always meet demand.

faq.q: Where are these cured skins shipped?
faq.answer: James Halloran’s finished goods leave Menethil Harbor aboard merchant vessels bound for major ports and markets across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can stalk the muddy edges of the Wetlands for crocolisk hides and supply Menethil Harbor’s leather trade.
